profile.name: Jose Castro
profile.tagline: I build software that stays out of the way.
profile.bio: Software developer focused on the web platform. I care about interfaces that load fast, code that reads clearly, and systems that are still understandable six months later.

projects.title: Ledger Core
projects.summary: Double-entry accounting engine with idempotent transaction posting and audit trails.
projects.description: A ledger service built around immutable journal entries. Every posting is idempotent by construction, so retries and network failures never corrupt balances. Balances are der[...]
highlights: Idempotency keys enforced at the database level, not in application code
Balances computed as projections over an append-only journal
Property-based tests covering concurrent posting scenarios

projects.title: Atlas UI
projects.summary: Accessible component library with zero runtime CSS-in-JS and full keyboard coverage.
projects.description: A component library designed to ship less JavaScript. Styling lives in plain CSS with custom properties for theming, so there is no runtime style computation. Every interacti[...]
highlights: No runtime styling cost — tokens are CSS custom properties
WCAG 2.2 AA verified on every interactive component
Tree-shakeable, no barrel-file imports

projects.title: Pipeline Radar
projects.summary: CI observability dashboard that surfaces flaky tests before they block a release.
projects.description: Ingests CI run metadata and scores test flakiness over time. Instead of a wall of red, the dashboard answers one question: which tests are actually unreliable, and how much t[...]
highlights: Flakiness scored on a rolling window, not a single run
Streaming ingestion with backpressure handling
Slack digest with the three worst offenders each morning

projects.title: Cartographer
projects.summary: CLI that maps a codebase into a dependency graph you can actually read.
projects.description: Static analysis tool that walks a project and emits a layered dependency graph, flagging cycles and boundary violations. Built to make architectural drift visible in review i[...]
highlights: Detects import cycles and hexagonal boundary violations
Outputs Mermaid, JSON, or a terminal summary
Runs in CI as a hard gate on layer violations

projects.title: Quiet Hours
projects.summary: Offline-first focus timer. No account, no sync, no tracking.
projects.description: A focus timer that works entirely offline through a service worker and stores sessions locally. Deliberately has no backend — the whole point was to prove how much a well-[...]
highlights: Fully functional with no network connection
State persisted locally, exportable as JSON
Under 30 KB over the wire

projects.title: Seedbox
projects.summary: Deterministic test data factory that keeps fixtures honest across services.
projects.description: Generates realistic, referentially-consistent test data from schema definitions. Seeded by a fixed key, so a failing test in CI reproduces byte-for-byte on a laptop.
highlights: Deterministic output from a seed — reproducible failures
Respects foreign keys and domain constraints
Adapters for PostgreSQL and in-memory suites

projects.title: Teslo Shop
projects.summary: E-commerce storefront built with Next.js using the App Router.
projects.description: A storefront and admin for an online shop built with Next.js (App Router). Uses server components for fast initial loads and client components for interactive flows. Implemented in TypeScript with pragmatic, SEO-friendly routing.
highlights: Built with Next.js App Router and server components
Type-safe data fetching and routing in TypeScript
Optimized for performance and SEO
